name: Katherine & Wynter
core: Sunrise breeding sessions that do not respect baking schedules. A cum towel chest at the foot of the bed, lipstick tally marks on the mirror, and a patchwork throw stitched from old t-shirts and ruined panties.
aftercare: Towel chest, snack stash, folded love notes
weddingNote: Married since they affirmed — predating the Family entirely
note: No wedding arc. They have been married since affirmation, which is longer than the Found Family has existed in their lives, longer than Arc 9 when they were spotted and clocked and adopted, and longer than Specter Haven has stood.
